title: False projection chart trace tail
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, $N\in\mathbf N$ with $NA=0$, and $t$ normalized finite twist transport [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]. Let $f:X\to S$ be proper, $P=\mathbf P^1_S$ with structure map $q$, and $i:X\xrightarrow{\sim}P$ with $i;q=f$. Assume $N$ is invertible in $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)$. Write $L_T=A_T(1)[2]$, $\mathbf1_T$ for the ordinary constant coefficient complex, $M=\mathrm{middleComparison}(f,i,\mathrm{false})$, and $C=\mathrm{constantComparison}(i)$, with the explicit maps of [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data]. Write $D=\mathrm{ordinaryFiniteP1DiagonalChartMap}(S,\mathrm{false})$ [lem-sf-p1-chart-exchange] and $B^{-1}=\mathrm{falseProjectionChartFactorInv}(S)$ for the displayed inverse chart factor [lem-sf-p1-projection-trace-transport-false-factor-cancel]. Explicitly, if $r:\mathbf P^1_P\to P$ and $m:\mathbf P^1_P\to P$ is the projective-space map induced by $q$, then $B^{-1}=Rr_*(l_m^{-1});\mathrm{ordinaryFiniteP1Exchange}(q,L_P)^{-1}$, where $l_m:m^*L_P\simeq L_{\mathbf P^1_P}$ is normalized shifted-line transport. For every arbitrary morphism $\tau:Rq_*L_P\to\mathbf1_S$, the false coordinate trace obeys the following equality, in application order:
$$M; i^*(D);i^*(B^{-1});i^*\bigl(q^*(\tau);\mathrm{ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback}(q)\bigr);C=\mathrm{coordinateTrace}(f,i,\tau,\mathrm{false}).$$
There is no trace-normalization or trace-base-change assumption on $\tau$.

proof.text: Use chartExchange and cancellation of falseProjectionChartFactor with its inverse to remove chart normalization.
Apply middle_exchange, which separates the normalized coefficient square from coefficient-independent exchange pasting.

Naturality of inverse supported self-exchange and proper forget-supports carries the inverse line comparison through the resulting composite. Naturality of the pullback compositor carries the arbitrary trace tau to the base.

Apply ordinaryFiniteUnitPullback_comp to i;q=f. The constantUnit_pullback equation identifies the resulting final unit path. The abstract trace-tail naturality helper folds the ordered trace factors into traceComposite, using the presentationTrace_assoc equation for the two direct-image factors. Specialize this folded equation and expand only coordinateTrace and trace, so no concrete shifted-line comparison needs to be normalized.
